name: prose-review
description: Three read-only critics and one revising transformer for prose. prose-voice-critic: does this sound like the author, judged against their own corpus. prose-fidelity-critic: did a revision keep what it had to, judged against the original and a deterministic scan. prose-structure-critic: does the structure carry the argument, judged against outline-scan and the intended outline. prose-reviser: applies a plan of edits and emits a change log the fidelity critic then judges. Every rewrite goes through the gate.
